sn48.39:1.4: Sukhavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati sukhindriyaṃ ||
sn48.39:1.5: so sukhito va samāno Sukhito smīti pajānāti || ||
sn48.39:1.6: tasseva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca Uppannaṃ sukhindriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānātīti || || 4.
sn48.39:2.1: Dukkhavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati dukkhindriyam
sn48.39:2.2: so dukkhito va samāno Dukkhito smīti pajānāti ||
sn48.39:2.3: tasseva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca Uppannaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ tam nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānāti || || 5.
sn48.39:3.1: Somanassavedaniyaṃ bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati somanassindriyaṃ ||
sn48.39:3.2: so sumano va samāno Sumano smīti pajānāti ||
sn48.39:3.3: tasseva somanassa vedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ somanassavedaniyaṃ phassam paṭicca Uppannaṃ somanassindriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānāti || || 6.
sn48.39:4.1: Domanassavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati domanassindriyaṃ ||
sn48.39:4.2: so dummano va samāno dummano smīti pajānāti ||
sn48.39:4.3: tasseva domanassavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhāyaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitam domanassavedaniyam phassam paṭicca Uppannam domanassindriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānāti || || 7.
sn48.39:5.1: Upekhāvedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati upekhindriyaṃ ||
sn48.39:5.2: so upekhako va samāno Upekhako smīti pajānāti
sn48.39:5.3: ||tasseva upekhāvedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ upekhāvedaniyam phassa paṭicca uppannam upekhindriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānāti || || 8.
sn48.39:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dvinnam kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanā samodhānā usmā jāyati || tejo abhinibbattati || tesaṃ yeva kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā nikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasammati || ||
sn48.39:6.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave sukhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppajjati sukhindriyaṃ ||
sn48.39:6.3: so sukhito va samāno Sukhito smīti pajānāti ||
sn48.39:6.4: tasseva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitam sukhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppannami sukhindriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānāti || ||
sn48.39:7.5: so upekhako va samāno Upekhako smīti pajānāti ||
sn48.39:7.6: tasseva upekhāvedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitam upekhāvedaniyaṃ phassam paṭicca uppannam upekhindriyaṃ || taṃ nirujjhati taṃ vūpasammatīti pajānātīti || || 2.
